name: Revile
overview: Scripture teaches that reviling, or speaking abusively against others, is forbidden, as seen in Exodus 22:28 where God commands not to revile the gods or curse rulers. Yet, Jesus acknowledges in Matthew 5:11 that His followers may be reviled and falsely accused for His sake, highlighting the believer's call to endure such trials. This endurance is exemplified in Hebrews 12:3, urging believers to consider Christ's patient endurance of opposition. Together, these verses reveal that while reviling is sinful, Christians are called to respond with steadfast faith, reflecting the character of the Word who was with God in the beginning (John 1:1).
